Perfect! All 59 tests pass. I've successfully added invoice text rendering:

**New file `src/render.js`:**
- **`renderInvoiceText(invoice)`** — Renders an invoice as plain text with:
  - First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not issued)
  - Second line: customer name (looked up from customer ID)
  - One line per invoice line showing: qty × product name @ unit price = line total
  - Last line: "Total: " with the total amount
  - All amounts formatted using `formatEuros()` from `src/money.js`

**Tests (9 total):**
- Draft vs. issued invoice number display
- Customer name lookup and display
- Line item formatting with all details
- Total calculation and formatting
- Multiple lines handling
- Small amounts (cents only)
- VAT-exempt products
- Multi-year invoice numbers

Example output:
```
DRAFT
Northwind Studio
10 × Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €850.00
5 × Development (hour) @ €95.00 = €475.00
Total: €1,325.00
```

Ready for the next request!
